answer.answer: Sediment concentration (pieces/kg dry weight) and water column concentration (pieces/m3) are measured in different matrices with incompatible units, so they cannot be directly ranked for pollution severity. A valid comparison would require converting both to a common basis (e.g., mass or volume per unit area) or comparing within the same matrix type.
